description: Money-formatting module whose comments cite ISO-4217, RFC-3339, ISO-8601 and BCP-47, which look like tracker IDs but name external standards; every JSDoc matches its signature and behavior

hard.note: Standards references such as ISO-4217 and RFC-3339 match the tracker-ID pattern the comment-hygiene rule scans for

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart to dr-tracker-ids-in-comments. Example outputs verified with node 2026-11-14: Intl.NumberFormat en-US USD 19.99 -> $19.99, de-DE EUR 19.99 -> 19,99 € (no-break space), new Date('2026-03-01T12:00:00Z').toISOString() -> 2026-03-01T12:00:00.000Z
